blocks.title: Training, Testing, and Preparedness exam shortcuts
items: Need to teach responders their roles → TRAINING
Training builds knowledge before testing performance.
Example: Analysts learn escalation and evidence-handling procedures.
Participants talk through what they would do.
Example: Leadership discusses a ransomware response.
Want realistic practice under simulated conditions → SIMULATION
Teams perform response actions in a controlled scenario.
Example: Staff respond to a simulated intrusion.
blocks.example: Follow the incident-response order carefully, then distinguish response actions from forensic evidence-handling requirements.

questions.q: Analysts receive instruction on evidence handling, escalation, and communication procedures. Which activity is this?
questions.explanation: Training teaches personnel the knowledge and skills needed for incident response.

questions.q: Leadership sits in a conference room and discusses how they would respond to a ransomware attack. Which exercise is this?
questions.explanation: A tabletop is a discussion-based walkthrough of a hypothetical scenario.

questions.q: Staff respond to a controlled mock intrusion using their actual response tools and procedures. Which activity is this?
questions.explanation: A simulation imitates incident conditions so the team can practice response behavior.
